Are you sure you have not sent this parcel? Where are you located?
Have you ever lost your Aadhar card?
Have you filed any complaint?
That must have been the reason. Someone has used your ID and sent this package to Malaysia. Now, you can be arrested for this. First, you will be under digital arrest and then a team of officials will reach your address to physically arrest you.
